levels.description:
Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage
Active Effect: <@ba.vdown>Stops attacking</> but <@ba.vup>Attack Range expands</>; grants <@ba.vup>{cnt}</> stones, then any stones above the limit <@ba.vup>are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies</>; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed <@ba.vup>on tiles with enemies</> and <@ba.vup>Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones</> at the cost of an equal amount of ammo
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {trigger_time} ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones</>
